entries.problem: Rapid programme indicator flashes quickly
entries.possibleCause: Water inlet time is too long. The water valve may be closed, the water inlet may be blocked, or the water pressure may be too low.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the water valve is open and that water is available. Check the accessible inlet hose for an obvious kink or blockage.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the indicator continues flashing after the water supply and accessible inlet have been checked.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the flashing Rapid programme indicator
description of the water valve check
description of the inlet hose check
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 35, FEHLERCODES UND MASSNAHMEN BEI STÃ–RUNGEN

entries.problem: Rapid and Self-cleaning programme indicators flash quickly
entries.possibleCause: The required temperature was not reached. The manual identifies a heating-element fault.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not open or repair the appliance. No safe customer repair check is specified.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim when the Rapid and Self-cleaning programme indicators flash quickly together.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing both flashing indicators
description of when the warning appeared
matchTerms: quick and self cleaning lights flashing
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 35, FEHLERCODES UND MASSNAHMEN BEI STÃ–RUNGEN

entries.problem: ECO programme indicator flashes quickly
entries.possibleCause: Overfilling. The manual states that part of the dishwasher is leaking.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the dishwasher and close the main water tap. If water is present in the lower tray because of overfilling or a small leak, it must be removed before restarting the dishwasher.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for this overfill or leakage condition.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the flashing ECO indicator
photo or video of visible water or leakage
description of where water is visible
description of when the overfill occurred
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 35, FEHLERCODES UND MASSNAHMEN BEI STÃ–RUNGEN

entries.problem: Rapid, 1-hour and ECO programme indicators flash quickly
entries.possibleCause: Communication fault between the main circuit board and the display circuit board. The circuit may be open or the communication connections may be damaged.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not open the appliance or inspect internal wiring. No safe customer check is specified.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim when these three programme indicators flash quickly together.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing all three flashing indicators
description of when the fault appeared
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 35, FEHLERCODES UND MASSNAHMEN BEI STÃ–RUNGEN

entries.problem: Rinse-aid warning indicator is lit
entries.possibleCause: There is only a small amount of rinse aid left in the dispenser.
entries.safeUserCheck: Refill the rinse-aid dispenser with rinse aid intended for household dishwashers.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the refill warning alone.
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 17 and 36, DISPLAY I BEDIENPANEL / FEHLERBEHEBUNG

entries.problem: Rinse aid needs refilling
entries.possibleCause: The rinse-aid warning indicates that only a small amount remains in the dispenser.
entries.safeUserCheck: Refill the rinse-aid dispenser without overfilling it. Wipe away any spilled rinse aid because the manual states that spills can cause excessive foam.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal rinse-aid refilling.
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 23-24, FÃ¼llen des KlarspÃ¼lbehÃ¤lters und Auswahl der Einstellungen

entries.problem: Regeneration-salt warning indicator is lit
entries.possibleCause: There is only a small amount of regeneration salt left in the dispenser.
entries.safeUserCheck: Refill with regeneration salt intended specifically for dishwashers. The warning may remain lit for a while after refilling while the salt dissolves.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the refill warning alone.
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 17 and 20, DISPLAY I BEDIENPANEL / Salz einfÃ¼llen

entries.problem: Dishwasher salt needs refilling
entries.possibleCause: The salt warning indicates that regeneration salt is low.
entries.safeUserCheck: Refill the salt container with regeneration salt intended for dishwashers. After refilling, start a wash programme immediately, preferably the Rapid programme. If salt was spilled, run the soaking or Rapid programme.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal salt refilling.

entries.problem: Self-cleaning reminder is shown
entries.possibleCause: The dishwasher requests self-cleaning after 20 cycles. The indicator flashes for 5 seconds and the reminder remains for 3 cycles.
entries.safeUserCheck: Run the Self-cleaning programme.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the normal self-cleaning reminder.

entries.problem: Dishwasher requires its self-cleaning programme
entries.possibleCause: The self-cleaning reminder is activated after 20 cycles.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select and run the Self-cleaning programme.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for running the normal self-cleaning programme.

entries.problem: Dishwasher gives an audible signal at the end of the wash cycle
entries.possibleCause: The audible signal indicates that the wash cycle has ended.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for the normal end-of-cycle audible signal alone.

entries.problem: Dishwasher door opens automatically during drying
entries.possibleCause: OpenDry automatically opens the door slightly during the drying phase to improve drying results with lower energy consumption.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not close the door when OpenDry has opened it during drying. The manual states that closing it can damage the appliance.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when the door opens automatically during the drying phase as described by the manual.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 31, Nach dem Ende des SpÃ¼lprogramms - OpenDry. Automatische TÃ¼rÃ¶ffnung

entries.problem: Dishwasher does not start
entries.possibleCause: The door may not be properly closed and latched, the appliance may not be connected to power, Start Delay may be selected, or the start/child lock may be enabled on applicable models.
entries.safeUserCheck: Close the door firmly and confirm it is latched. Check the normal power connection. Check whether Start Delay is selected. If fitted, disable the start/child lock according to the operating instructions.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the dishwasher still does not start after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the control panel when starting is attempted
description of the power and Start Delay checks

entries.problem: Dishwasher does not fill with water
entries.possibleCause: The water valve may be closed or the door lock may not be correctly engaged.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the water valve is open and make sure the dishwasher door is fully closed.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the dishwasher still does not fill after the water valve and door checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the control panel

entries.problem: Wash cycle takes longer than expected
entries.possibleCause: Programme duration can increase depending on how dirty the dishes are. Selecting the sanitizing option also extends the cycle so the required temperature can be reached. The manual also instructs checking the water connection.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check which programme and options were selected and whether the load is heavily soiled. Check the accessible water connection as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if unusually long operation continues and cannot be explained by the selected programme, option, soil level, or water connection.

entries.problem: Dishes are not clean enough
entries.possibleCause: The manual lists temporarily low water pressure, incoming water that is too cold, dishes placed too close together, incorrect detergent use, an unsuitable wash programme, or a blocked spray arm.
entries.safeUserCheck: Use the dishwasher when water pressure is normal. Reload the dishes according to the manual and make sure the spray arms can turn freely. Adjust detergent use to the water hardness and selected programme. Select a suitable longer programme if needed.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if cleaning remains poor after the supported loading, spray-arm, detergent, programme and water-supply checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of dishes after the completed cycle
description of loading and spray-arm checks

entries.problem: Dishes are not dry enough
entries.possibleCause: The rinse-aid supply may be empty or insufficient, the dishes may be loaded incorrectly, or the selected programme may not include a drying phase.
entries.safeUserCheck: Refill the rinse-aid dispenser or increase the rinse-aid setting as described in the manual. Reload dishes correctly and choose a programme with a drying phase.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if dishes remain abnormally wet after the rinse-aid, loading and programme checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of dishes after a completed cycle

entries.problem: Spots or deposits remain on dishes
entries.possibleCause: The manual lists very hard water, incorrect loading, old rinse aid, an empty rinse-aid dispenser, too much detergent with soft water, or incoming water above 70Â°C.
entries.safeUserCheck: Reload the dishes correctly. Refill with fresh rinse aid if needed. If the water is soft, use less detergent. Check the incoming water temperature only through normal household controls without dismantling the dishwasher.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if spotting or deposits continue after the supported rinse-aid, detergent, loading and water-condition checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the spots or deposits

entries.problem: Detergent remains in the dispenser after washing
entries.possibleCause: The detergent may be too old or a spray arm may be blocked.
entries.safeUserCheck: Use fresh detergent. Reload the dishwasher so that no dish blocks the spray arm and verify that the spray arm can move freely.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if detergent repeatedly remains in the dispenser after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of detergent remaining in the dispenser

entries.problem: Detergent-dispenser lid does not close correctly
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that the detergent-dispenser flap may not be functioning correctly.
entries.safeUserCheck: Use the dispenser only as described in the operating instructions. Do not force, dismantle or repair the flap.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the detergent-dispenser flap cannot be closed or used normally.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the dispenser flap
description of what happens when closing the flap

entries.problem: Water remains in the dishwasher after washing
entries.possibleCause: The previous wash programme may not have completed or may have been interrupted. The manual also lists food residue or broken glass blocking the pump.
entries.safeUserCheck: Confirm that the wash programme was allowed to finish. Do not dismantle the pump or reach into an inaccessible area if broken glass is suspected.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if water remains after a complete programme or if an inaccessible pump blockage or broken glass is suspected.
evidenceToRequest: description of whether the programme completed

entries.problem: Dishwasher does not drain water correctly
entries.possibleCause: The drain may be blocked or the drain hose may be kinked.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check the accessible sink trap or drain connection. Check that the visible drain hose is not kinked and is correctly connected.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if drainage is still incorrect after the accessible drain and hose checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the accessible drain-hose routing

entries.problem: Excessive foam inside the dishwasher
entries.possibleCause: The wrong type of detergent has been used.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the detergent is specifically suitable for household dishwashers.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if excessive foaming continues while correct dishwasher detergent is being used. Stop using the appliance and create an urgent claim if foam causes a leak or flooding.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the foam
photo or name of the detergent used

entries.problem: Dishwasher is leaking water
entries.possibleCause: The troubleshooting table lists deposits caused by unsuitable detergent and the dishwasher not being level. The fault section also identifies leakage as a cause of overfilling.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the dishwasher and close the water supply. Do not dismantle the appliance.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for an active water leak or flooding.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the leak
photo showing where the water appears
description of when the leak occurs
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 35 and 38, FEHLERCODES UND MASSNAHMEN BEI STÃ–RUNGEN / FEHLERBEHEBUNG

entries.problem: Black or grey marks appear on dishes
entries.possibleCause: Aluminium items may have come into contact with the dishes.
entries.safeUserCheck: Reload the dishwasher so aluminium items do not contact the affected dishes.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if the marks are caused by aluminium contact.

entries.problem: Inside of dishwasher is stained or discoloured
entries.possibleCause: The manual identifies coffee and tea deposits and reddish staining.
entries.safeUserCheck: For coffee or tea deposits, use a suitable certified stain-removal product as described in the manual. For reddish staining, run a wash programme after loading the dishes.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is normally required for the staining described in the manual.

entries.problem: Noise occurs when the detergent-dispenser lid opens or the drain pump operates
entries.possibleCause: The manual explicitly states that this noise is normal.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required if the sound occurs only during normal dispenser opening or drain-pump operation.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a claim for this normal operating sound alone.

entries.problem: Unusual noise continues after a complete programme
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that a hard object may have fallen into the dishwasher mechanism.
entries.safeUserCheck: Allow one complete programme to finish. Do not dismantle the appliance to search for an internal object.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the noise does not stop after one complete programme.
evidenceToRequest: video or audio recording of the noise
description of when during the cycle the noise occurs
description of whether it continued after a full programme

entries.problem: Inside of dishwasher is wet after the cycle
entries.possibleCause: The manual explicitly states that a wet dishwasher interior after use is normal.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required for moisture inside the dishwasher alone.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for normal internal moisture alone.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 31, Nach dem Ende des SpÃ¼lprogramms

entries.problem: Filter system is dirty or may become blocked
entries.possibleCause: The filter system collects larger residues during washing. These residues can block the filters.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the appliance from the mains before maintenance. Check the filters regularly. Remove the filter assembly as described in the manual, rinse larger residues under running water, clean more thoroughly with a soft clean cloth if needed, then reinstall the filters carefully. Never operate the dishwasher without the filters.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the related problem continues after the filters have been correctly cleaned and reinstalled.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the filter condition before cleaning
photo of the cleaned and reinstalled filter
description of the problem remaining after cleaning
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 32-33, REINIGUNG UND WARTUNG - Reinigen der InnenflÃ¤chen / Filtersystem

entries.problem: Spray arms are dirty or blocked
entries.possibleCause: The spray-arm nozzles and bearings can become blocked by substances associated with hard water.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the appliance from the mains before maintenance. Remove the upper and lower spray arms using the user-maintenance procedure in the manual. Clean them with a soft brush in warm soapy water, rinse them, and reinstall them.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the spray arms remain blocked or the related washing problem continues after cleaning.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the spray arms or blocked nozzles
photo or video showing whether the spray arms move freely
description of the problem after cleaning

entries.problem: Current wash programme needs to be cancelled or changed
entries.possibleCause: A wash cycle can only be changed if it has been running for a short time. If it has run longer, detergent may already have been released and wash water may already have been drained.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the door slightly to stop the dishwasher. Wait until the spray arm stops before opening the door fully. Hold the Programme button for more than 3 seconds to cancel the current programme and return the appliance to standby. Select the required programme. If detergent has already been released, refill the detergent dispenser.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for a normal programme reset or cancellation.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, EINSCHALTEN DES GERÃ„TS UND PROGRAMMWAHL - Programmwechsel

entries.problem: Wash programme was interrupted or did not finish
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that water may remain in the dishwasher when the previous wash programme was not fully completed or was interrupted.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select the appropriate programme and allow it to complete normally. If changing a running programme, use the programme-reset procedure described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the dishwasher still cannot complete a programme or water remains after a complete programme.
evidenceToRequest: photo of any water remaining inside
description of when the programme was interrupted
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 30 and 37, EINSCHALTEN DES GERÃ„TS UND PROGRAMMWAHL - Programmwechsel / FEHLERBEHEBUNG

entries.problem: A forgotten dish needs to be added during a running programme
entries.possibleCause: A forgotten dish can be added before the detergent dispenser has opened.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the door only slightly to stop washing. Wait until the spray arms have stopped before opening the door fully. Add the forgotten dish and close the door. The dishwasher resumes after 10 seconds. Opening the door during washing can expose the customer to hot steam and cause burns.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when adding a forgotten dish according to the manual.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, EINSCHALTEN DES GERÃ„TS UND PROGRAMMWAHL - EinrÃ¤umen von Geschirr wÃ¤hrend des SpÃ¼lvorgangs

entries.problem: Dishwasher has visible transport damage before use
entries.possibleCause: The manual instructs the customer to check the appliance for transport damage before installation.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not start or use a damaged appliance.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim and contact the seller if the appliance is damaged or there is doubt about its condition.
evidenceToRequest: description of when the damage was noticed
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 6, WICHTIGE SICHERHEITSHINWEISE - Vor dem Aufstellen

entries.problem: Power cable is damaged
entries.possibleCause: The manual does not give a customer-repairable cause. It states that power-cable replacement must only be performed by authorised service or a qualified electrician.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the appliance. Disconnect it from the mains only if this can be done safely. Do not repair or replace the cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for a damaged power cable or exposed electrical parts.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged cable if safe to take
description of when the problem occurred
